decisions_made.decision: Q6 (maximize-binary-reverse-append) ships with the CORRECTED sample: for 00001 the true optimum is 00010 (final 10000), not the user's transcribed 00001 (final 00001)
decisions_made.rationale: The reverse-append procedure is a fixed position-permutation (verified by the user's own example-2 walkthrough); under it 00010 -> 10000 strictly beats 00001. decisions_made.decision: Q6 is graded by exact/token compare on the single output permutation (no special judge)
decisions_made.rationale: For the unique maximum final string the input permutation is the unique preimage (transform is a bijection), so there is exactly one correct answer -- a normal comparator suffices

decisions_made.decision: To push a bank change to live WITHOUT the logged-in UI: fly ssh -> git pull on /data/problems (with -c safe.directory=/data/problems) -> reindex inline via `cd /app/app && python3 -c "import store; from runner import problems; store.reindex_problems(problems.all_meta())"`
decisions_made.rationale: All /api/ write routes (bank/sync, reindex) require GitHub OAuth, unusable headless; the app does NOT auto-pull or reindex-on-boot (only reindexes if the index is empty). The DB is a shared SQLite file, so an out-of-process reindex is picked up by the server
